A_leadership_midsize.note: Leadership roles only at mid-size companies. If the company is much smaller, cap the score at 5. If it's much larger, re-check it as tier B.

B_senior_ic_large_vendor.company_type: Software / SaaS vendors about Odoo's size or bigger (Salesforce, Microsoft, SAP, Oracle, Zoho, HubSpot, ServiceNow, Workday, Cloudflare, etc.)

C_adjacent.note: Relevant roles that don't fit A or B exactly. Score them on merit.

markets.exclude: Egypt-based roles unless they're regional MENA or remote

boost: Manages a team or a regional P&L
Full-cycle new-logo selling to SMB and mid-market
Arabic speaker preferred, or GCC experience required
Industries he has sold into: construction, manufacturing, hospitality, industrial

exclude.other: Commission-only roles, and pure marketing, pre-sales or customer-success roles with no revenue quota.

lusha_hiring_manager_lookup.note: Off until the shortlist quality is proven. When it's on, look up the hiring manager only for jobs scored 8 or higher, and only reveal emails (1 credit each).
